summary: Iteration 2 testing of PearBlue app: backend Projects CRUD + Contact regression (pytest 7/7 pass) and frontend UI/integration flows (navbar, theme toggle, pricing, services, projects add/detail, contact & footer KVK). All critical requirements verified end-to-end.

issues: The Boekweitkamp address is rendered ABOVE the [data-testid=contact-kvk] block (in the 'Address' contact detail row), so the address text is NOT inside the contact-kvk block. The KVK number 87201607 IS inside contact-kvk. Not a functional bug — data is present on the page — but the review-request wording implied both KVK + address should be inside data-testid='contact-kvk'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If the acceptance criterion requires 'Boekweitkamp 7 9932MA Delfzijl' to be inside the [data-testid=contact-kvk] element, add the street address inside that block on /contact (currently it lives in the Address row above).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DELETE /api/projects/{id} returns 200 with a body — consistent with tests; could be 204 for stricter REST, but acceptable.
Projects.jsx (~320 lines) and Services.jsx are large but readable; consider extracting the ProjectForm modal into its own component for maintainability.
No auth on POST/DELETE /api/projects — public users can add or delete projects. Fine for MVP but flag: add admin auth before production.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows pass; only minor address-location nit)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed projects during tests. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers projects CRUD + contact regression. Frontend tested via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: navbar has no Portfolio link, theme-toggle toggles html.dark and persists 'pb_theme' localStorage; Home pricing-section has pricing-card-{web,ict,cyber} each with features + CTA to /contact; Services /diensten has service-section-{ict,media,cyber} with 6/6/4 items and Dutch titles present when NL locale active (HTML-encodes '&' as '&', so exact-string checks may show false-negatives — verified visually + count-wise); Projects /projecten shows page-projects, opens project-modal on card click, projects-add-button opens project-form with title/image/category inputs, submit creates project (verified via GET /api/projects), filter buttons projects-filter-{all,ecom,ai,sec,media,infra,corp} all present; Contact shows +31 596 229 030 and contact-kvk with KVK 87201607; Footer has footer-kvk with 87201607, footer-link-projects → /projecten, and phone +31 596 229 030.
